node.title: Smart-City Mobility Chaos
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: The City That Stopped Safely · A multi-actor failure case about local correctness, shared resources and regime drift · Executive reading path.

relations: The constructed smart-city scenario can inform a new shared-capacity test inspired by Tuxpan, without claiming that its fictional failure occurred in the historical service.
Analogía posterior y escenario construido de 2026; no ensayo urbano ni episodio observado del caso.
A constructed shared-capacity scenario could test whether locally valid mobility decisions remain coherent at the declared system boundary.
No se afirma ejecución del ensayo, producción implantada o fallo observado de Mobility OS.
